The problem

Managing a household today means juggling six apps and a mental load that never switches off.

You've got Helpling for the cleaner. Kaodim for the handyman. A WhatsApp thread with the aircon guy who replies three days late. A mental note to reorder laundry pickup. And when something goes wrong — a no-show, a half-finished job, a price that doubled mid-task — there's nobody holding anyone accountable.

You're not a homeowner anymore. You're a project manager — for a project that never ends, with vendors who don't talk to each other, and no system of record for what was done, what was paid, and what you actually liked.

That's the before.

Why it's different

Accountability, built into every job.

Prepayment losses are one of the most common consumer complaints in Singapore's home-services sector. Anna.I is built to make that impossible.

Milestone escrow

Your payment is held securely and released to the vendor only when the job is verified complete — with photo proof. No chasing refunds for work that wasn't done.

Verified vendor network

Every vendor passes background checks and identity verification before joining. Performance is tracked over time — not just one-off star ratings.

Photo-verified completion

Vendors upload photo proof of completed work. You see it before payment releases. It's the accountability layer home services has always been missing.

S$8.6m

Prepayment losses filed with CASE Singapore in a single recent year — across renovation, home services, and similar sectors. It's the structural problem Anna.I's escrow model is designed to solve.

Source: CASE Singapore
